snapshot.comment:
Qualified user-approved CLIC polymer candidate only; not a measured industrial recipe, commercial-grade equivalence or scientific certification. Existing lifetime purchases and all unrelated exchanges are preserved. Automatic propagation does not authorize changes to protected PV dependency closures.

One shared dry, unreinforced acid-form EW1100 engineering reference for PEM, VRFB and the already-linked HFB application. Net NaOH/HCl chemistry is an engineering variant, not the source's KOH/HNO3 workup. Intermediate conversion100%, finished retention90% once. Keep10 kg process water,39.31 MJ aggregate heat and1 kWh electricity/kg once; the cited39.31 MJ forming reference is not a measured complete chemical-factory energy budget. No automatic extra carrier water. Purification, auxiliaries, reinforcement, hydration, PFAS fugitives and specific fluoride/HF abatement remain coverage gaps, not zero-emission claims.
